\begin{tikzpicture}
	\begin{pgfonlayer}{nodelayer}
		\node [style=Process] (0) at (0, 3) {Start};
		\node [style=Decision] (1) at (0, 1.5) {OK?};
		\node [style=Process] (2) at (3, 1.5) {Fix};
		\node [style=Process] (3) at (0, 0) {Done};
	\end{pgfonlayer}
	\begin{pgfonlayer}{edgelayer}
		\draw [style=Arrow] (0) to[bend left] (1);

		\draw [style=Arrow, bend right=45] (2) to (0);
		\draw [style=Arrow] (1) to (3);
	\end{pgfonlayer}
